About staging releases

These are test builds of the VettID vault. They run only in VettID's staging environment, which holds no real accounts, and are never offered to members. Production releases have their own log at vettid.org/security/releases.

Each staging release is listed in the staging channel's signed manifest at /.well-known/vettid/pcr-manifest.json, which staging builds of the app verify with the staging key built into them. This log is generated from that manifest, so the two cannot disagree; the manifest's history is public in the vettid.org repository.

Staging releases are built reproducibly from the public vettid-vault source like production ones, and replaced and ended much faster.
